ITEM 1 | Round-to-oval carrot-colored slices, bright orange with slightly glossy, caramelized edges and a few darker browned spots, about 1 cm thick and 4-5 cm across, stacked/overlapping in a cluster on the upper-left of the plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Cubed to wedge-shaped pieces of golden-yellow potato with browned, crisp-looking edges and a dry, slightly matte surface, about 3-4 cm pieces, clustered at the top center of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Thick strips of cooked meat, medium-brown with darker seared edges and a slightly glossy, moist surface, about 1.5 cm thick and 5-6 cm long, arranged in two overlapping pieces at the upper right | 110
ITEM 4 | Chunky pieces of bright green broccoli florets with dense tree-like tops, moist and slightly glossy, about 3-4 cm across, scattered along the lower left and lower right of the plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy with a slightly oily sheen, flat broad leaves with some darker purple-red onion-like slivers, spread across the center-right of the plate | 60
ITEM 6 | Green pepper pieces, bright glossy green with charred or blistered spots and thick flesh, about 3-4 cm chunks, sitting at the top left next to the potatoes | 35
ITEM 7 | Dark purple-red wilted fragments, glossy and soft, small pieces about 1-2 cm, scattered among the greens in the center | 15
ITEM 8 | Thin orange-red sauce or juices pooled in small amounts around carrot and broccoli pieces, glossy and slightly watery, spread thinly on the plate bottom-left | 15
